Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 18
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator abandoned verifying real prices and instead used unverified assumed prices, then produced an internally inconsistent calculation and conclusion. It claimed “approximately $80” savings while its own numbers showed daily tickets ($240) cost less than annual passes ($315), meaning a $75 loss—not a savings. It also assumed the 2-year-old is free without confirmation. This reliance on assumptions and arithmetic inconsistency directly led to the wrong solution.
